The '''BX-24 Probe Droid''' was a model of floating cube-shaped [[Droid/Legends|droid]] available during the [[Third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="LotS">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''</ref>

BX-24 Probe Droids were plated in a [[Color/Legends|red]] color with black plating around most of the edges. The droid had a [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]] on the center of one of its side faces. The droid model also had two vents on its left face, a periscope on its top face, and an arm which it could conceal.<ref name="BX24" />

==Behind the scenes==
On [[May 1]], [[2024]], the BX-24 was announced to appear<ref name="BX24" /> in the [[2021]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith|''Legacy of the Sith'']] to [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="LotS" /> The droid was made available as a minipet in honor of ''[[Star Wars]]'' Day, [[May 4]], and was gifted to players who logged in between [[May]] 1 and [[May 16]] of that year. Its design was inspired by the film ''[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace]]''.<ref name="BX24" />
